name: linux-post-help-prints-usage-not-posts
description: Per-subcommand help footgun fix (defect #7): `post --help` prints the post USAGE and exits 0 WITHOUT posting. Regression lock -- per-subcommand --help/-h used to fall through to the command (post --help posted an empty NOTE to the discussion; wait --help started a real blocking wait). Help is intercepted before dispatch, so this case needs no mock, no token, and no network.
